```{r}
#dotplot of selected effector genes
gene_markers <- c(
  "Foxp3","Il2ra", "Lrrc32", "Areg", "Ctla4", "Il10", "Gzma", "Gzmb",
  "Tgfb1", "Ebi3", "Entpd1", "Nt5e", "Ccr7", "Nr4a1", "Cxcr5", "Il1rl1", "Rorc", "Tbx21", "Pdcd1", "Icos", "Tnfrsf19", "Ikzf2", "Mki67"
)


gene_markers <- c(
  "Il2ra", "Lrrc32", "Areg", "Ctla4", "Il10", "Gzma", "Gzmb",
  "Tgfb1", "Ebi3", "Entpd1", "Nt5e")


DefaultAssay(treg_object) <- "RNA"

clusters_drop <- c("Treg.wM")

treg_rna <- subset(
  treg_object,
  subset = !(annotation_level2 %in% clusters_drop)
)
DefaultAssay(treg_rna) <- "RNA"

treg_rna <- NormalizeData(
  treg_rna,
  assay = "RNA",
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000
)

genes_use <- intersect(gene_markers, rownames(treg_rna[["RNA"]]))

expr_mat <- GetAssayData(treg_rna, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")[genes_use, , drop = FALSE]

meta_df <- treg_rna@meta.data %>%
  mutate(cell = rownames(.)) %>%
  select(cell, annotation_level2)

expr_df <- as.matrix(expr_mat) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = "cell",
    values_to = "log1p_cp10k"
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_df, by = "cell")

dp_df <- expr_df %>%
  group_by(annotation_level2, gene) %>%
  summarise(
    pct.exp = mean(log1p_cp10k > 0) * 100,
    avg.log1p_cp10k = mean(log1p_cp10k),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dp_df$gene <- factor(dp_df$gene, levels = rev(genes_use))

base_size <- 10
axis_size <- 9
mid_val <- median(dp_df$avg.log1p_cp10k)

p_rna <- ggplot(dp_df, aes(x = annotation_level2, y = gene)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = pct.exp, fill = avg.log1p_cp10k),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.12
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "darkblue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "red",
    midpoint = mid_val,
    name = "Avg log1p(CP10K)"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "% expressing",
    range = c(0.25, 6),
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
    limits = c(0, 100)
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.04))) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.04))) +
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = axis_size,
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 1,
      margin = margin(t = 1)
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = axis_size,
      lineheight = 0.85,
      margin = margin(r = 1)
    ),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
    legend.title = element_text(size = base_size),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = base_size - 1)
  ) +
  guides(
    size = guide_legend(title = "% expressing"),
fill = guide_colorbar(title = "Avg log1p(CP10K)", barheight = unit(20, "mm")) )

pdf("Treg_effector_dotplot_log1pCP10K_052626.pdf", width = 4.375, height = 2.5, useDingbats = FALSE)
print(p_rna)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
#dotplot of conditions/clusters, but treg

treg_object@meta.data <- treg_object@meta.data %>%
  mutate(
    condition_detailed_simplified = case_when(
      condition_detailed_simplified %in% c("SFB", "SFB_pregnancy") ~ "SFB",
      TRUE ~ condition_detailed_simplified
    )
  )


treg_object@meta.data <- treg_object@meta.data %>%
  mutate(
    condition_detailed_simplified = case_when(
      condition_detailed_simplified %in% c("PDAC", "PDAC_aPD1aCTLA4", "PDAC_FishHFD", "PDAC_SoyHFD") ~ "PDAC",
      condition_detailed_simplified %in% c("GBMclass", "GBMclass_aPD1aCTLA4",
                                           "GBMmes", "GBMmes_aPD1aCTLA4",
                                           "GBMpron", "GBMpron_aPD1aCTLA4") ~ "GBM",
      condition_detailed_simplified %in% c("B16_ACT", "B16_ACTaPD1a41BB") ~ "B16",
      condition_detailed_simplified %in% c("HeartTransplant_rejection",
                                           "HeartTransplant_tolerance") ~ "HeartTransplant",
      TRUE ~ condition_detailed_simplified
    )
  )


treg_object <- subset(
  treg_object,
  subset = !condition_detailed_simplified %in% c(
    "MHCIIhet_Ea16", "MHCIIhet",
    "MHCIIKO_Ea16", "MHCIIKO",
    "KbDbKO", "KbDbKO_MCMV",
    "KbDbQa1KO", "KbDbQa1KO_MCMV", "other"
  )
)


treg_object <- subset(
  treg_object,
  subset = !(condition_detailed_simplified == "B16" &
             condition_broad == "healthy")
)

cond_col    <- "condition_detailed_simplified"
cluster_col <- "annotation_level2"
broad_col   <- "condition_broad"

base_size <- 6.5
axis_size <- 6

treg_metadata <- treg_object@meta.data

broad_order <- c(
  "healthy", "bacteria", "fungus", "virus", "parasite",
  "multiinfection", "autoimmune", "allergy", "cancer",
  "immunization", "allotransplant"
)

treg_metadata <- treg_metadata %>%
  mutate(
    condition_broad = factor(condition_broad, levels = broad_order)
  )

cond_to_broad <- treg_metadata %>%
  dplyr::count(
    condition = .data[[cond_col]],
    broad     = .data[[broad_col]],
    name = "cells"
  ) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  slice_max(cells, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

dotplot <- treg_metadata %>%
  dplyr::count(
    condition = .data[[cond_col]],
    cluster   = .data[[cluster_col]],
    name = "n"
  ) %>%
  left_join(cond_to_broad, by = "condition") %>%
  filter(!is.na(condition), !is.na(cluster), !is.na(broad)) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n), prop = n / total) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    n_log10 = log10(n + 1),
    broad   = factor(broad, levels = broad_order)
  )

cond_levels <- dotplot %>%
  distinct(condition, broad, total) %>%
  arrange(broad, desc(total), condition) %>%
  pull(condition)

dotplot <- dotplot %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = rev(cond_levels)))
side_df <- dotplot %>% distinct(condition, broad)
broad_levels <- levels(droplevels(dotplot$broad))

broad_cols <- c(
  "#4477AA", "#88CCEE", "#332288", "#117733", "#CCBB44",
  "#DDCC77", "#EE6677", "#FF9933", "#AA3377", "#DD5522", "#991111"
)
broad_cols <- broad_cols[seq_len(length(broad_levels))]
names(broad_cols) <- broad_levels



p_side <- ggplot(side_df, aes(x = 1, y = condition, fill = broad)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = broad_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = base_size - 2),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.18, "cm"),
    legend.key.width  = unit(0.38, "cm"),
    legend.key = element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Condition broad", nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))

legend_broad <- get_legend(p_side)
p_side_noleg <- p_side +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(2, 0, 2, 0))

p_main <- ggplot(dotplot, aes(x = cluster, y = condition)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_log10, fill = prop),
             shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkgreen",
                      limits = c(0, 0.25), oob = squish) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Cells per dot (log10)", range = c(1.5, 8)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = axis_size - 1, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_size - 1, lineheight = 0.75),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.1),
    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 0)
  ) +
  guides(
    size = guide_legend(title = "Cells per dot (log10)"),
    fill = guide_colorbar(title = "Mean proportion")
  )

bottom_row <- plot_grid(
  p_side_noleg, p_main,
  ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.02, 0.98),
  align = "h", axis = "tb"
)

pdf("treg_condition_dotplot_032326.pdf",
    width = 5.0, height = 7.5, useDingbats = FALSE)
plot_grid(legend_broad, bottom_row, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.05, 0.95))
dev.off()
```

```{r}
#flow vs rna radar plots
igt_flow <- read.csv("igt_flow3.csv", row.names = 1)
rownames(igt_flow) <- c("thymus", "bone marrow", "blood", "spleen", "LN", "lung", "colon", "small intestine", "peritoneal cavity", "liver")
treg_object_clean <- subset(treg_object,subset = !annotation_level2 %in% c("Treg.P", "Treg.wM"))
healthy_subset <- subset(treg_object_clean, subset = condition_broad == "healthy")
#subset to only include samples with >20 cells
sample_counts <- healthy_subset@meta.data %>%
  count(sample_code, name = "cell_count") %>%
  filter(cell_count > 20)

healthy_subset_filtered <- subset(healthy_subset, subset = sample_code %in% sample_counts$sample_code)

NormalizeData(healthy_subset_filtered, assay = "ADT", normalization.method = "LogNormalize")

flow_subset <- subset(healthy_subset_filtered, subset = organ_simplified %in% c("thymus", "bone marrow", "blood", "spleen", "LN", "lung", "colon", "small intestine", "peritoneal cavity", "liver"))

annotation_counts <- flow_subset@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample_code, organ_simplified, annotation_level2) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")


total_sample_data <- annotation_counts %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = annotation_level2, values_from = count, values_fill = 0)
total_sample_data$total <- rowSums(total_sample_data[, 3:8])

total_sample_data <- total_sample_data %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = starts_with("Treg."),
    .fns = ~ .x / total,
    .names = "prop_{.col}"
  ))

prop_long <- total_sample_data %>%
  dplyr::select(organ_simplified, dplyr::starts_with("prop_")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::starts_with("prop_"),
    names_to = "annotation_level2",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(annotation_level2 = sub("prop_", "", annotation_level2))



prop_long$percent <- prop_long$proportion * 100

prop_summary_ann <- prop_long %>%
  group_by(organ_simplified, annotation_level2) %>%
  summarise(
    med = median(percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sd(percent, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
cl1_flow <- igt_flow %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("Cl1."))
cl1_flow$med_flow <- apply(cl1_flow, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
cl1_flow$sem_flow <- apply(cl1_flow, 1, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x))))
cl1_flow$organ_simplified <- rownames(cl1_flow)
cl1_flow <- cl1_flow %>%
  arrange(med_flow)
prop_summary_cl1 <- subset(prop_summary_ann, subset = annotation_level2 == "Treg.A")
joined_data_cl1 <- left_join(cl1_flow, prop_summary_cl1)
#cluster 2

cl2_flow$med_flow <- apply(cl2_flow, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
cl2_flow$sem_flow <- apply(cl2_flow, 1, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x))))
cl2_flow$organ_simplified <- rownames(cl2_flow)
cl2_flow <- cl2_flow %>%
  arrange(med_flow)
prop_summary_cl2 <- subset(prop_summary_ann, subset = annotation_level2 == "Treg.D")
joined_data_cl2 <- left_join(cl2_flow, prop_summary_cl2)
#cluster 3
cl3_flow <- igt_flow %>%
 dplyr:: select(starts_with("Cl3."))
cl3_flow$med_flow <- apply(cl3_flow, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
#cl8_flow$sd <- apply(cl8_flow, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
cl3_flow$sem_flow <- apply(cl3_flow, 1, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x))))
cl3_flow$organ_simplified <- rownames(cl3_flow)
cl3_flow <- cl3_flow %>%
  arrange(med_flow)

prop_summary_cl3 <- subset(prop_summary_ann, subset = annotation_level2 == "Treg.B")
joined_data_cl3 <- left_join(cl3_flow, prop_summary_cl3)

#cluster 4

##Cluster 8
cl8_flow <- igt_flow %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("Cl8."))
cl8_flow$med_flow <- apply(cl8_flow, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
#cl8_flow$sd <- apply(cl8_flow, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
cl8_flow$sem_flow <- apply(cl8_flow, 1, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x))))
cl8_flow$organ_simplified <- rownames(cl8_flow)
cl8_flow <- cl8_flow %>%
  arrange(med_flow)

prop_summary_cl8 <- subset(prop_summary_ann, subset = annotation_level2 == "Treg.E")
joined_data_cl8 <- left_join(cl8_flow, prop_summary_cl8)
#Cluster 6
cl6_flow <- igt_flow %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("Cl6."))
cl6_flow$med_flow <- apply(cl6_flow, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
#cl8_flow$sd <- apply(cl8_flow, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
cl6_flow$sem_flow <- apply(cl6_flow, 1, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x))))
cl6_flow$organ_simplified <- rownames(cl6_flow)
cl6_flow <- cl6_flow %>%
  arrange(med_flow)
prop_summary_cl6 <- subset(prop_summary_ann, subset = annotation_level2 == "Treg.C")
joined_data_cl6 <- left_join(cl6_flow, prop_summary_cl6)
#combining meds/sds into one large data frame
cl1_trimmed <- joined_data_cl1[, -(1:4)]
cl2_trimmed <- joined_data_cl2[, -(1:5)]
cl3_trimmed <- joined_data_cl3[, -(1:5)]
cl4_trimmed <- joined_data_cl4[, -(1:5)]
cl6_trimmed <- joined_data_cl6[, -(1:5)]
cl8_trimmed <- joined_data_cl8[, -(1:5)]
total_flow_seq <- rbind(cl1_trimmed, cl2_trimmed, cl3_trimmed, cl4_trimmed, cl8_trimmed)


library(ggradar)
library(fmsb)
organs <- unique(total_flow_seq$organ_simplified)

for (org in organs) {
  sub_df <- subset(total_flow_seq, organ_simplified == org)
  annotations <- sub_df$annotation_level2
  
  flow_med   <- setNames(sub_df$med_flow, annotations)
  flow_upper <- setNames(sub_df$med_flow + sub_df$sem_flow, annotations)
  flow_lower <- setNames(sub_df$med_flow - sub_df$sem_flow, annotations)
  
  rna_med    <- setNames(sub_df$med, annotations)
  rna_upper  <- setNames(sub_df$med + sub_df$sem, annotations)
  rna_lower  <- setNames(sub_df$med - sub_df$sem, annotations)
  
  radar_data <- rbind(
    max = rep(100, length(annotations)),
    min = rep(0, length(annotations)),
    Flow      = flow_med,
    Flow_hi   = flow_upper,
    Flow_lo   = flow_lower,
    RNAseq    = rna_med,
    RNAseq_hi = rna_upper,
    RNAseq_lo = rna_lower
  )
  
  radar_data <- as.data.frame(radar_data)
  colnames(radar_data) <- annotations
  radar_data[is.na(radar_data)] <- 0
  
  colors_border <- c("blue", "blue", "blue", "red", "red", "red")
  colors_fill   <- c("#0000FF40", NA, NA, "#FF000040", NA, NA)
  
  par(mar = c(3, 3, 4, 3), xpd = TRUE) 
  
  radarchart(radar_data,
             axistype = 1,
             pcol = colors_border,
             pfcol = colors_fill,
             plwd = c(2, 1, 1, 2, 1, 1),
             plty = c(1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2),
             cglcol = "grey", cglty = 1,
             axislabcol = "grey",
             vlcex = 0.8,
             title = paste("Flow vs RNAseq cluster proportions -", org))
  
  legend("topleft", inset = c(0, -0.15), horiz = TRUE,
         legend = c("Flow", "+/-SEM_FLOW", "RNA-seq", "+/-SEM_SEQ"),
         col = c("blue", "blue", "red", "red"),
         lty = c(1, 2, 1, 2),
         lwd = c(2, 1, 2, 1),
         bty = "n",
         xpd = TRUE,
         cex = 0.75)

  n_vars <- length(annotations)
  angles <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_vars + 1)[- (n_vars + 1)]
  
  usr <- par("usr")
  x_center <- mean(usr[1:2])
  y_center <- mean(usr[3:4])
  radius <- min(diff(usr[1:2]), diff(usr[3:4])) / 2 * 1.05
  
  for (i in seq_along(annotations)) {
    angle <- angles[i]
    
    base_x <- x_center + radius * sin(angle)
    base_y <- y_center + radius * cos(angle)
    
    label_offset <- 0.08 * radius
    
    flow_val <- round(radar_data["Flow", i], 1)
    rna_val  <- round(radar_data["RNAseq", i], 1)
    
    text(base_x, base_y - label_offset, 
         labels = paste0("Flow: ", flow_val), 
         col = "blue", cex = 0.6, font = 2)
    
    text(base_x, base_y - (3 * label_offset), 
         labels = paste0("RNA: ", rna_val), 
         col = "red", cex = 0.6, font = 2)
  }
}
```

```{r}
#top 10 pathways per cluster
library(fgsea)
library(gt)
library(msigdbr)


h_df <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "H")

kegg_medicus <- msigdbr(
  species = "Mus musculus",
  category = "C2",
  subcategory = "CP:KEGG_MEDICUS"
)

kegg_legacy <- msigdbr(
  species = "Mus musculus",
  category = "C2",
  subcategory = "CP:KEGG_LEGACY"
)

pathways_df <- bind_rows(
  h_df %>% mutate(collection = "H"),
  kegg_medicus %>% mutate(collection = "KEGG_MEDICUS"),
  kegg_legacy %>% mutate(collection = "KEGG_LEGACY")
)

pathways <- pathways_df %>%
  split(x = .$gene_symbol, f = .$gs_name)

treg_object_clean <- subset(
  treg_object,
  subset = annotation_level2 %in% c("Treg.A", "Treg.B", "Treg.C", "Treg.D", "Treg.E", "Treg.F")
)
Idents(treg_object_clean) <- "annotation_level2"

markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  treg_object_clean,
  assay = "RNA",
  slot = "data",
  only.pos = FALSE,
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0.05,
  test.use = "wilcox"
)

markers_ranked <- markers %>%
  filter(!is.na(avg_log2FC)) %>%
  mutate(rank_metric = avg_log2FC)

gsea_results <- markers_ranked %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  map_dfr(function(df) {
    ranks <- df %>%
      arrange(desc(rank_metric)) %>%
      distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      select(gene, rank_metric) %>%
      deframe()

    fgsea(
      pathways    = pathways,
      stats       = ranks,
      minSize     = 10,
      maxSize     = 500,
      nPermSimple = 10000
    ) %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      mutate(cluster = unique(df$cluster))
  })


top10_up <- gsea_results %>%
  filter(NES > 0, padj < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  arrange(desc(NES), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

top10_up_forexport <- top10_up %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    Cluster = cluster,
    Pathway = pathway,
    NES,
    padj
  )

write_csv(top10_up_forexport, "top10percluster.csv" )
```

```{r}
#with david's code
tmp <- readRDS("ttlist_OneVsAll_newest.Rds")
clusters <- grep("^Treg..*_vs_All$", names(tmp), value = TRUE)

rank_list <- lapply(clusters, function(cl) {
  df <- tmp[[cl]]
  ranks <- df$logFC
  names(ranks) <- df$SYMBOL
  ranks <- ranks[!is.na(names(ranks))]
  ranks <- ranks[!duplicated(names(ranks))]
  ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)
  
  return(ranks)
})

names(rank_list) <- clusters

message("Loading signatures")

load("signaturelist20241120.Rda")
signaturelist1 <- signaturelist

load("signaturelistGSEA.Rda")
signaturelist2 <- signaturelist

signaturelist <- c(signaturelist1, signaturelist2)

fgseaRes <- map_dfr(names(rank_list), function(cl) {
  fgseaMultilevel(
    pathways = signaturelist,
    stats = rank_list[[cl]],
    scoreType = "pos",
    minSize = 5
  ) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(cluster = cl)
})

fgseaRes

#top 10 per cluster
top10 <- fgseaRes %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(NES > 0, !is.na(padj)) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = padj, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    neglog10_padj = -log10(padj),
    pathway = as.character(pathway)
  )

write_csv(top10, "top10_fgsea_pathways.csv")
```

```{r}
#Upon immune perturbations, proportion of SLO vs NLT per conditions. Probably as a stacked (SLos vs NLT) horizontal histogram ranked from the highest to lowest -- no filter


s1c <- treg_object@meta.data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(condition_detailed_simplified),
    !is.na(organ_simplified)

  mutate(
    compartment = case_when(
      organ_simplified %in% c("spleen", "LN", "SLO") ~ "SLO",
      TRUE ~ "NLT"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(condition_detailed_simplified, compartment) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    condition_detailed_simplified,
    compartment = c("SLO", "NLT"),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(condition_detailed_simplified) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    plot_prop = ifelse(compartment == "SLO", -prop, prop)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

  filter(compartment == "NLT") %>%
  arrange(desc(prop)) %>%
```

```{r}
#pathway analysis - this one works
library(msigdbr)
library(fgsea)
library(Seurat)
library(stringr)

assay_use <- "RNA"

Idents(treg_object) <- "annotation_level2"

de <- FindMarkers(
  treg_object,
  ident.1    = "Treg.F",
  ident.2    = NULL,
  assay      = assay_use,
  test.use   = "wilcox",
  logfc.threshold = 0.25, 
  min.pct    = 0.1
)

de$gene <- rownames(de)
de <- de %>%
  mutate(
    sign_fc   = sign(avg_log2FC),
    rank_stat = sign_fc * (-log10(p_val + 1e-300))
  )

ranks <- setNames(de$rank_stat, de$gene)
ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

species <- "Mus musculus"
m_c2    <- msigdbr(species = species, category = "C2") %>%
  select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
m_all   <- m_c2 %>% filter(grepl("^(KEGG_|REACTOME_|WP_)", gs_name))
genesets <- split(m_all$gene_symbol, m_all$gs_name)

canon     <- function(x) x |> toupper() |> str_replace_all("[^A-Z0-9]+", "_") |> str_replace_all("^_|_$", "")
gs_names  <- names(genesets)
canon_map <- setNames(gs_names, canon(gs_names))
pick_set  <- function(label) {
  key <- canon(label)
  if (key %in% names(canon_map)) canon_map[[key]] else NA_character_
}
safe_file <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", x)

targets <- c(
  "KEGG_LEUKOCYTE_TRANSENDOTHELIAL_MIGRATION",
  "REACTOME_RAP1_SIGNALLING",
  "WP_REGULATION_OF_ACTIN_CYTOSKELETON"
)

grDevices::pdf.options(useDingbats = FALSE)

for (lbl in targets) {
  nm <- pick_set(lbl)
  if (is.na(nm)) { message("No pathway found for: ", lbl); next }

  pw_genes <- intersect(unique(genesets[[nm]]), names(ranks))
  if (length(pw_genes) < 1) { message("Too few overlapping genes for: ", nm); next }

  res <- fgsea(
    pathways = list(this = pw_genes),
    stats    = ranks,
    minSize  = 1, maxSize = Inf,
    nperm    = 10000
  ) |> as.data.frame()

  p <- fgsea::plotEnrichment(pw_genes, ranks) +
    ggtitle(
      nm,
      subtitle = sprintf("NES = %.2f, FDR = %.2g  [Treg.F vs all]",
                         res$NES[1], res$padj[1])
    ) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12))

  print(p)

  outfile <- paste0(safe_file(nm), "_enrichment.pdf")
  tryCatch({
    ggplot2::ggsave(filename = outfile, plot = p,
                    device = grDevices::cairo_pdf,
                    width = 9, height = 5, units = "in", bg = "white")
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("PDF failed for ", nm, ". Falling back to PNG.")
    ggplot2::ggsave(filename = paste0(safe_file(nm), "_enrichment.png"),
                    plot = p, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  })
}
```

```{r}
  "Treg.A",

  group_by(sample_code, organ_simplified) %>%

    cols = all_of(gate_cols),
    names_to = "annotation_level2",
    values_to = "is_in_gate"
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_code, organ_simplified, annotation_level2) %>%
  summarise(count = sum(is_in_gate, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(sample_totals, by = c("sample_code", "organ_simplified")) %>%

    proportion = count / total,
    percent = proportion * 100
  )

prop_summary_ann <- gate_counts %>%
  group_by(organ_simplified, annotation_level2) %>%
  summarise(
    med = median(percent, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sd(percent, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


a_flow <- igt_flow %>%
  select(starts_with("Treg.A."))
a_flow$med_flow <- apply(a_flow, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
a_flow$sem_flow <- apply(a_flow, 1, function(x) sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(x))))
a_flow$organ_simplified <- rownames(a_flow)
a_flow <- a_flow %>% arrange(med_flow)

prop_summary_a <- prop_summary_ann %>%
  filter(annotation_level2 == "Treg.A")
joined_data_a <- left_join(a_flow, prop_summary_a, by = "organ_simplified")

d_flow <- igt_flow %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("Treg.D."))
d_flow$med_flow <- apply(d_flow, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)

keep_cols <- c("organ_simplified", "annotation_level2", "med_flow", "sem_flow", "med", "sem")

total_flow_seq <- bind_rows(
  joined_data_a[, keep_cols],
  joined_data_d[, keep_cols],
  joined_data_b[, keep_cols],
  joined_data_e[, keep_cols],
  joined_data_f[, keep_cols]
)


#actualy plotting
organs <- unique(total_flow_seq$organ_simplified)

for (org in organs) {
  sub_df <- subset(total_flow_seq, organ_simplified == org)
  annotations <- sub_df$annotation_level2

  flow_med   <- setNames(sub_df$med_flow, annotations)
  flow_upper <- setNames(sub_df$med_flow + sub_df$sem_flow, annotations)
  flow_lower <- setNames(sub_df$med_flow - sub_df$sem_flow, annotations)

  cite_med   <- setNames(sub_df$med, annotations)
  cite_upper <- setNames(sub_df$med + sub_df$sem, annotations)
  cite_lower <- setNames(sub_df$med - sub_df$sem, annotations)

  radar_data <- rbind(
    max        = rep(100, length(annotations)),
    min        = rep(0, length(annotations)),
    Flow       = flow_med,
    Flow_hi    = flow_upper,
    Flow_lo    = flow_lower,
    CITEseq    = cite_med,
    CITEseq_hi = cite_upper,
    CITEseq_lo = cite_lower
  )

  radar_data <- as.data.frame(radar_data)
  colnames(radar_data) <- annotations
  radar_data[is.na(radar_data)] <- 0

  colors_border <- c("blue", "blue", "blue", "red", "red", "red")
  colors_fill   <- c("#0000FF40", NA, NA, "#FF000040", NA, NA)

  par(mar = c(3, 3, 4, 3), xpd = TRUE)

  radarchart(
    radar_data,
    axistype = 1,
    pcol = colors_border,
    pfcol = colors_fill,
    plwd = c(2, 1, 1, 2, 1, 1),
    plty = c(1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2),
    cglcol = "grey",
    cglty = 1,
    axislabcol = "grey",
    vlcex = 0.8,
    title = paste("Flow vs CITE-seq gated cluster proportions -", org)
  )

  legend(
    "topleft",
    inset = c(0, -0.15),
    horiz = TRUE,
    legend = c("Flow", "+/-SEM_FLOW", "CITE-seq", "+/-SEM_CITE"),
    col = c("blue", "blue", "red", "red"),
    lty = c(1, 2, 1, 2),
    lwd = c(2, 1, 2, 1),
    bty = "n",
    xpd = TRUE,
    cex = 0.75
  )

  n_vars <- length(annotations)
  angles <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_vars + 1)[-(n_vars + 1)]

  usr <- par("usr")
  x_center <- mean(usr[1:2])
  y_center <- mean(usr[3:4])
  radius <- min(diff(usr[1:2]), diff(usr[3:4])) / 2 * 1.05

  for (i in seq_along(annotations)) {
    angle <- angles[i]

    base_x <- x_center + radius * sin(angle)
    base_y <- y_center + radius * cos(angle)

    label_offset <- 0.08 * radius

    flow_val <- round(radar_data["Flow", i], 1)
    cite_val <- round(radar_data["CITEseq", i], 1)

    text(
      base_x, base_y - label_offset,
      labels = paste0("Flow: ", flow_val),
      col = "blue", cex = 0.6, font = 2
    )

    text(
      base_x, base_y - (3 * label_offset),
      labels = paste0("Cite: ", cite_val),
      col = "red", cex = 0.6, font = 2
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
get_flow_summary <- function(flow_df, cluster_name) {
  sub <- flow_df %>%
    select(starts_with(paste0(cluster_name, ".")))

  out <- data.frame(
    organ_simplified = rownames(sub),
    annotation_level2 = cluster_name,
    med_flow = apply(sub, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  out
}
```

```{r}
MyFeaturePlotHighlight <- function (seurat_object, feature, cells_to_highlight, umap_to_plot = "umap", 
    assay = "RNA", colors = viridis::viridis(10), title = "", 
    pixels = c(512, 512), highlight_size = 1, highlight_alpha = 1, 
    xlim = NULL, ylim = NULL, background_alpha = 0.1) 
{
    dim_data <- seurat_object[[umap_to_plot]]@cell.embeddings
    dim1 <- dim_data[, 1]
    dim2 <- dim_data[, 2]
    tmp_all <- data.frame(seurat_object@meta.data, dim1 = dim1, 
        dim2 = dim2)
    p_base <- ggplot2::ggplot(tmp_all) + scattermore::geom_scattermore(ggplot2::aes(x = dim1, 
        y = dim2), color = "grey", pointsize = 1, alpha = background_alpha, 
        pixels = pixels)
    feature_expr <- Seurat::GetAssayData(seurat_object, assay = assay, 
        layer = "data")[feature, ]
    tmp_highlight <- tmp_all[cells_to_highlight, ]
    tmp_highlight$feature_value <- feature_expr[cells_to_highlight]
    p_final <- p_base + ggplot2::geom_point(data = tmp_highlight, 
        ggplot2::aes(x = dim1, y = dim2, color = feature_value), 
        size = highlight_size, alpha = highlight_alpha) + ggplot2::scale_color_gradientn(colours = colors, 
        name = feature) + ggplot2::theme_void() + NoGrid() + 
        ggplot2::labs(title = title, x = paste0(umap_to_plot, 
            "_1"), y = paste0(umap_to_plot, "_2"))
    if (!is.null(xlim) || !is.null(ylim)) {
        p_final <- p_final + ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim, 
            ylim = ylim)
    }
    return(p_final)
}

pdf("040226_treg_f_cd69_myfeatureplot_adt.pdf", width = 8, height = 8, useDingbats = F)
MyFeaturePlotHighlight(
  seurat_object      = treg_object,
  feature            = "CD69",
  cells_to_highlight = cells_to_highlight,
  umap_to_plot       = "mde_incremental",
  assay              = "ADT",
  colors = c("lightgrey", "blue"),

  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = "cell",
    values_to = "log1p_cp10k"
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_df, by = "cell")

dp_df <- expr_df %>%
  group_by(annotation_level2, gene) %>%
  summarise(
    pct.exp = mean(log1p_cp10k > 0) * 100,
    avg.log1p_cp10k = mean(log1p_cp10k),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dp_df$gene <- factor(dp_df$gene, levels = rev(genes_use))

base_size <- 10
axis_size <- 3
mid_val <- median(dp_df$avg.log1p_cp10k)

p_rna <- ggplot(dp_df, aes(x = annotation_level2, y = gene)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = pct.exp, fill = avg.log1p_cp10k),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.12
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "darkblue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "red",
    midpoint = mid_val,
    name = "Avg log1p(CP10K)"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "% expressing",
    range = c(0.25, 6),
    breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
    limits = c(0, 100)
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = axis_size,
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 1,
      margin = margin(t = 1)
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = axis_size,
      lineheight = 0.85,
      margin = margin(r = 1)
    ),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
    legend.title = element_text(size = base_size),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = base_size - 1)
  ) +
  guides(
    size = guide_legend(title = "% expressing"),
fill = guide_colorbar(title = "Avg log1p(CP10K)", barheight = unit(20, "mm")) )

pdf("Treg_RNA_dotplot_log1pCP10K_cd69klf2.pdf", width = 4.375, height = 1.5, useDingbats = FALSE)
print(p_rna)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
#pseudotime
library("monocle3")
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(igraph)


cell_df <- as.data.frame(reducedDims(cds)$UMAP)
colnames(cell_df) <- c("Dim1", "Dim2")
cell_df$cell <- rownames(cell_df)

meta_df <- as.data.frame(colData(cds)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("cell")

plot_df <- left_join(cell_df, meta_df, by = "cell")

node_mat <- principal_graph_aux(cds)[["UMAP"]]$dp_mst
node_df <- as.data.frame(t(node_mat))
colnames(node_df) <- c("Dim1", "Dim2")
node_df$node <- rownames(node_df)


g <- principal_graph(cds)[["UMAP"]]
edge_df <- igraph::as_data_frame(g, what = "edges")

edge_df <- edge_df %>%
  left_join(node_df, by = c("from" = "node")) %>%
  rename(x = Dim1, y = Dim2) %>%
  left_join(node_df, by = c("to" = "node")) %>%
  rename(xend = Dim1, yend = Dim2)


p_clusters_manual <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Dim1, y = Dim2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = annotation_level2), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(
  data = edge_df,
  aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  linewidth = 1.1,
  color = "black",
  arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.08, "inches"), type = "closed")
) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "MDE 1", y = "MDE 2", color = "Cluster")

print(p_clusters_manual)

ggsave(
  "Treg_MDE_monocle_trajectory_clusters.pdf",
  plot = p_clusters_manual,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  useDingbats = FALSE
)


p_pseudotime_manual <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Dim1, y = Dim2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = pseudotime(cds)[cell]), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(
  data = edge_df,
  aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  linewidth = 1.1,
  color = "black",
  arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.08, "inches"), type = "closed")
) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "MDE 1", y = "MDE 2", color = "Pseudotime")

print(p_pseudotime_manual)

ggsave(
  "Treg_MDE_monocle_trajectory_pseudotime.pdf",
  plot = p_pseudotime_manual,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  useDingbats = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
#candidate ligands for tissue tregs
treg_object_clean <- subset(treg_object,subset = annotation_level2 %in% c("Treg.A", "Treg.B" ,"Treg.C", "Treg.D", "Treg.E", "Treg.F"))
Idents(treg_object_clean) <- "annotation_level2"

cluster_use <- "Treg.E"

de_cl4 <- FindMarkers(
  treg_object_clean,
  ident.1 = cluster_use,
  ident.2 = NULL,
  assay = "RNA",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0.1
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  as_tibble()

data(CellChatDB.mouse)
cellchat_db <- CellChatDB.mouse

lr_db <- cellchat_db$interaction %>%
  as_tibble()

ligand_genes <- unique(lr_db$ligand)
receptor_genes <- unique(lr_db$receptor)

ligands_cl4 <- de_cl4 %>%
  filter(gene %in% ligand_genes) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC))

receptors_cl4 <- de_cl4 %>%
  filter(gene %in% receptor_genes) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC))

avg_expr <- AverageExpression(
  treg_object_clean,
  assays = "RNA",
  group.by = "annotation_level2",
  slot = "data"
)$RNA

avg_expr <- avg_expr %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene")

lr_from_cl4 <- lr_db %>%
  filter(ligand %in% ligands_cl4$gene)

ligand_expr_cl4 <- avg_expr %>%
  select(gene, !!cluster_use) %>%
  rename(ligand_expr_cl4 = !!cluster_use)

lr_from_cl4 <- lr_from_cl4 %>%
  left_join(ligand_expr_cl4, by = c("ligand" = "gene"))

receptor_expr_long <- avg_expr %>%
  filter(gene %in% lr_from_cl4$receptor) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = "receiver_cluster",
    values_to = "receptor_expr"
  ) %>%
  rename(receptor = gene)

lr_from_cl4_long <- lr_from_cl4 %>%
  left_join(receptor_expr_long, by = "receptor")

ligand_stats <- ligands_cl4 %>%
  select(
    gene,
    avg_log2FC,
    p_val_adj,
    pct.1,
    pct.2
  ) %>%
  rename(
    ligand = gene,
    ligand_log2FC = avg_log2FC,
    ligand_padj = p_val_adj,
    ligand_pct_cl4 = pct.1,
    ligand_pct_other = pct.2
  )

lr_from_cl4_long <- lr_from_cl4_long %>%
  left_join(ligand_stats, by = "ligand")

lr_candidates <- lr_from_cl4_long %>%
  filter(
    ligand_expr_cl4 > 0.25,
    receptor_expr > 0.25,
    ligand_log2FC > 0.25,
    ligand_padj < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(ligand_log2FC), desc(receptor_expr))

lr_candidates %>%
  select(ligand, receptor, receiver_cluster, ligand_log2FC, ligand_expr_cl4, receptor_expr) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  head(50)

lr_to_cl4 <- lr_db %>%
  filter(receptor %in% receptors_cl4$gene)

receptor_expr_cl4 <- avg_expr %>%
  select(gene, !!cluster_use) %>%
  rename(receptor_expr_cl4 = !!cluster_use)

lr_to_cl4 <- lr_to_cl4 %>%
  left_join(receptor_expr_cl4, by = c("receptor" = "gene"))

ligand_expr_long <- avg_expr %>%
  filter(gene %in% lr_to_cl4$ligand) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene,
    names_to = "sender_cluster",
    values_to = "ligand_expr"
  ) %>%
  rename(ligand = gene)

lr_to_cl4_long <- lr_to_cl4 %>%
  left_join(ligand_expr_long, by = "ligand")

receptor_stats <- receptors_cl4 %>%
  select(
    gene,
    avg_log2FC,
    p_val_adj,
    pct.1,
    pct.2
  ) %>%
  rename(
    receptor = gene,
    receptor_log2FC = avg_log2FC,
    receptor_padj = p_val_adj,
    receptor_pct_cl4 = pct.1,
    receptor_pct_other = pct.2
  )

lr_to_cl4_long <- lr_to_cl4_long %>%
  left_join(receptor_stats, by = "receptor")

incoming_candidates <- lr_to_cl4_long %>%
  filter(
    receptor_expr_cl4 > 0.25,
    ligand_expr > 0.25,
    receptor_log2FC > 0.25,
    receptor_padj < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(receptor_log2FC), desc(ligand_expr))

incoming_candidates %>%
  select(sender_cluster, ligand, receptor, ligand_expr, receptor_expr_cl4, receptor_log2FC) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  head(50)

top_pairs <- lr_candidates %>%
  select(ligand, receptor, receiver_cluster, receptor_expr) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  slice_head(n = 30)

heat_df <- top_pairs %>%
  unite("pair", ligand, receptor, sep = " -> ") %>%
  select(pair, receiver_cluster, receptor_expr) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = receiver_cluster, values_from = receptor_expr)

heat_mat <- heat_df %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(heat_mat) <- heat_mat$pair
heat_mat$pair <- NULL
heat_mat <- as.matrix(heat_mat)

pheatmap(heat_mat, scale = "none")
```


```{r}
#pseudotime 042626 - slingshot
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(slingshot)
treg_object_clean <- subset(treg_object, subset = annotation_level2 %in% c("Treg.A", "Treg.B", "Treg.C", "Treg.D", "Treg.E", "Treg.F"))
sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(treg_object_clean)
reducedDim(sce, "MDE") <- Embeddings(treg_object_clean, "mde_incremental")
sce <- slingshot(
  sce,
  clusterLabels = "annotation_level2",
  reducedDim = "MDE",
  start.clus = "Treg.A"
)

pt <- slingPseudotime(sce)
treg_object_clean$pseudotime_slingshot <- pt[, 1]

FeaturePlot(
  treg_object_clean,
  features = "pseudotime_slingshot",
  reduction = "mde_incremental"
)

#plotting pt on mde colored by annotation_level2
mde <- Embeddings(treg_object_clean, "mde_incremental")

plot_df <- data.frame(
  MDE1 = mde[,1],
  MDE2 = mde[,2],
  cluster = treg_object_clean$annotation_level2,
  pseudotime = treg_object_clean$pseudotime_slingshot
)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(MDE1, MDE2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.25, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = palette_vector) +
  theme_classic() +
  coord_equal()

ggplot(plot_df, aes(MDE1, MDE2, color = pseudotime)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.25, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", na.value = "grey80") +
  theme_classic() +
  coord_equal()

plot(
  reducedDim(sce, "MDE"),
  col = palette_vector[as.character(sce$annotation_level2)],
  pch = 16,
  cex = 0.3,
  asp = 1
)

lines(SlingshotDataSet(sce), lwd = 2)

#trying to add arrows to show direction?
plot(
  reducedDim(sce, "MDE"),
  col = palette_vector[as.character(sce$annotation_level2)],
  pch = 16,
  cex = 0.3,
  asp = 1,
  bty = "n"
)

curves <- slingCurves(sce)

for (i in seq_along(curves)) {
  crv <- curves[[i]]$s
    lines(crv[,1], crv[,2], lwd = 2, col = "black")
    arrow_pos <- round(seq(10, nrow(crv) - 10, length.out = 4))
  
  for (j in arrow_pos) {
    arrows(
      x0 = crv[j, 1],
      y0 = crv[j, 2],
      x1 = crv[j + 5, 1],
      y1 = crv[j + 5, 2],
      length = 0.08,
      lwd = 2,
      col = "black"
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
## All
line_pairs_All <- read.csv("testAll.csv")  ## starting csv with jaccard index for each pair
line_pairs_All <- line_pairs_All[line_pairs_All$X1 != line_pairs_All$X2, ]  ## no duplicates
#library(dplyr)

## create the pairs for plotting - this helps you plot the line to connect any two clusters that you want to connect
centroid_pairs <- merge(
  mde_centroids,
  mde_centroids,
  by = NULL
) %>%
  filter(level2.x < level2.y)

line_pairs_All$level2MDE_1.x <- "NA"
line_pairs_All$level2MDE_2.x <- "NA"
line_pairs_All$level2MDE_1.y <- "NA"
line_pairs_All$level2MDE_2.y <- "NA"

## add co-ordinates to final dataframe for each pair for plotting
for (i in 1:length(rownames(line_pairs_All))) {
  single_pair <- centroid_pairs[centroid_pairs$level2.x == line_pairs_All$X1[i] & centroid_pairs$level2.y == line_pairs_All$X2[i], ]
  if(dim(single_pair)[1] != 0) {
    line_pairs_All$level2MDE_1.x[i] = single_pair$level2MDE_1.x
    line_pairs_All$level2MDE_2.x[i] = single_pair$level2MDE_2.x
    line_pairs_All$level2MDE_1.y[i] = single_pair$level2MDE_1.y
    line_pairs_All$level2MDE_2.y[i] = single_pair$level2MDE_2.y
  }
}

line_pairs_All <- line_pairs_All[line_pairs_All$level2MDE_1.x != "NA", ]
line_pairs_All$level2MDE_1.x <- as.numeric(line_pairs_All$level2MDE_1.x)
line_pairs_All$level2MDE_2.x <- as.numeric(line_pairs_All$level2MDE_2.x)
line_pairs_All$level2MDE_1.y <- as.numeric(line_pairs_All$level2MDE_1.y)
line_pairs_All$level2MDE_2.y <- as.numeric(line_pairs_All$level2MDE_2.y)

#library(ggrastr)
line_pairs_All$log2 <- log2(line_pairs_All$X3)  ## Not used

## OPTIONAL - Filter out those with low jaccard index
line_pairs_All <- line_pairs_All[line_pairs_All$X3 > 0.1, ]

## Create plot with legend - uncomment "# + NoLegend()" to remove legend
All_plot_legend <- ggplot() + geom_point_rast(CD4_mde, mapping = aes(x = level2MDE_1, y = level2MDE_2, colour = level2), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) + 
  geom_point(mde_centroids[mde_centroids$level2 %in% line_pairs_All$X1 | mde_centroids$level2 %in% line_pairs_All$X2, ], mapping = aes(x = level2MDE_1, y = level2MDE_2), size = 10 , colour = "black") +
  geom_point(mde_centroids[mde_centroids$level2 %in% line_pairs_All$X1 | mde_centroids$level2 %in% line_pairs_All$X2, ], mapping = aes(x = level2MDE_1, y = level2MDE_2, colour = level2), size = 9) + scale_colour_manual(values = mypal_level2_all) +
  geom_segment(data = line_pairs_All, aes(x = level2MDE_1.x, y = level2MDE_2.x, xend = level2MDE_1.y, yend = level2MDE_2.y, linewidth = X3)) + #, arrow = arrow(length = unit(2.5, "mm"), type = "closed", ends = "both")) + 
  #scale_linewidth(range = c(0.2, 1.5)) +
  scale_linewidth(range = c(2*min(line_pairs_All$X3), 2*max(line_pairs_All$X3))) +  ## scale linewidth to show differene in linewidth
  theme_classic() # + NoLegend()

## Save plot as pdf
pdf("All_Plot_Points_Centroids_lines_legend.pdf", width = 15, height = 15)
All_plot_legend
dev.off()

## Save raw and plot range 
All_range <- c(2*min(line_pairs_All$X3), 2*max(line_pairs_All$X3))
write.table(All_range, "All_range.txt")
All_range_raw <- c(min(line_pairs_All$X3), max(line_pairs_All$X3))
write.table(All_range_raw, "All_range_raw.txt")
```

```{r}
#treg vs all - have to run on midway
so_orig = readRDS("igt1_96_withtotalvi20260206_clean.Rds") 
so_orig = NormalizeData(so_orig, assay = "RNA", normalization.method = "LogNormalize")
meta_orig <- so_orig@meta.data

so_orig$level1_Treg_vs_rest <- ifelse(
  so_orig$annotation_level1 == "Treg",
  "Treg",
  "Rest"
)

so_orig$pb_group <- paste(
  so_orig$IGTHT,
  so_orig$level1_Treg_vs_rest,
  sep = "."
)

pb <- AggregateExpression(
  object = so_orig,
  assay = "RNA",
  group.by = "pb_group",
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000,
  return.seurat = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
)


cell_counts <- so_orig@meta.data %>%
  count(pb_group, name = "n_cells")

pb_meta <- pb@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("pb_id") %>%
  mutate(
    IGTHT = sub("\\.(Treg|Rest)$", "", pb_group),
    group = sub("^.*\\.(Treg|Rest)$", "\\1", pb_group)
  ) %>%
  left_join(cell_counts, by = "pb_group")

pb@meta.data <- pb_meta %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("pb_id")

meta <- pb@meta.data %>%
  filter(n_cells >= 10)

valid_samples <- meta %>%
  count(IGTHT, group) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  filter(Treg > 0, Rest > 0) %>%
  pull(IGTHT)

meta <- meta %>% filter(IGTHT %in% valid_samples)
pb_sub <- pb[, rownames(meta)]

dge <- DGEList(counts = pb_sub@assays$RNA$counts)
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)

meta$group <- factor(meta$group, levels = c("Rest", "Treg"))
meta$IGTHT <- factor(meta$IGTHT)

design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group + IGTHT, data = meta)
colnames(design) <- gsub("^group", "", colnames(design))
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))

keep <- filterByExpr(dge, design)
dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)

v <- voom(dge, design, plot = FALSE)
fit <- lmFit(v, design)

contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(
  Treg_vs_Rest = Treg - Rest,
  levels = design
)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

tt <- topTable(
  fit2,
  coef = "Treg_vs_Rest",
  number = Inf,
  adjust.method = "BH",
  sort.by = "P"
)

tt$SYMBOL <- rownames(tt)
tt$contrast <- "Treg_vs_Rest"
tt$min_cells <- min(meta$n_cells)
tt$n_pairs <- length(unique(meta$IGTHT))

tt %>%
  filter(adj.P.Val < 1e-300) %>%
  arrange(desc(logFC)) %>%
  select(SYMBOL, logFC, P.Value, adj.P.Val) %>%
  head(30)

vplot <- na.omit(data.frame(
  SYMBOL = tt$SYMBOL,
  fc = 2^(tt$logFC),
  pval = tt$adj.P.Val + 1e-300,
  AveExpr = 2^(tt$AveExpr)
))

p <- Vplot(
  vplot = vplot,
  xlab = "Treg_vs_Rest",
  xlimits = c(min(vplot$fc[vplot$fc != 0]), max(vplot$fc)),
  ylimits = c(min(vplot$pval), 1)
)

top_up <- vplot %>%
  mutate(log2fc = log2(fc)) %>%
  filter(log2fc > 1, pval < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(desc(log2fc)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 50) %>%
  pull(SYMBOL)

top_down <- vplot %>%
  mutate(log2fc = log2(fc)) %>%
  filter(log2fc < 0, pval < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(log2fc) %>%
  slice_head(n = 50) %>%
  pull(SYMBOL)

highlight_genes <- unique(c(top_up, top_down))
highlight_filter <- vplot$SYMBOL %in% highlight_genes

pdf("Treg_vs_Rest_volcano_052226.pdf",
    width = 10,
    height = 10,
    useDingbats = FALSE)

print(
  p +
    geom_point(
      data = vplot,
      aes(x = fc, y = pval),
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = vplot[highlight_filter, ],
      aes(x = fc, y = pval, label = SYMBOL),
      color = "black",
      box.padding = 0.5,
      point.padding = 0.3,
      max.overlaps = Inf
    )
)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
#for each - have to run this in midway
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(ggrepel)
library(ZemmourLib)

so_orig <- readRDS("igt1_96_withtotalvi20260206_clean.Rds")
so_orig <- NormalizeData(
  so_orig,
  assay = "RNA",
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize"
)

level1_groups <- sort(unique(so_orig$annotation_level1))

for (grp in level1_groups) {

  message("Running: ", grp)
  so_orig$group_tmp <- ifelse(
    so_orig$annotation_level1 == grp,
    grp,
    "Rest"
  )
  so_orig$pb_group <- paste(
    so_orig$IGTHT,
    so_orig$group_tmp,
    sep = "."
  )

  pb <- AggregateExpression(
    object = so_orig,
    assay = "RNA",
    group.by = "pb_group",
    normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
    scale.factor = 10000,
    return.seurat = TRUE,
    verbose = FALSE
  )

  cell_counts <- so_orig@meta.data %>%
    count(pb_group, name = "n_cells")

  pb_meta <- pb@meta.data %>%
    rownames_to_column("pb_id") %>%
    mutate(
      IGTHT = sub(paste0("\\.(", grp, "|Rest)$"), "", pb_group),
      group = sub(paste0("^.*\\.(", grp, "|Rest)$"), "\\1", pb_group)
    ) %>%
    left_join(cell_counts, by = "pb_group")

  pb@meta.data <- pb_meta %>%
    column_to_rownames("pb_id")

  meta <- pb@meta.data %>%
    filter(n_cells >= 10)

  valid_samples <- meta %>%
    count(IGTHT, group) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = group,
      values_from = n,
      values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    filter(.data[[grp]] > 0, Rest > 0) %>%
    pull(IGTHT)

  meta <- meta %>%
    filter(IGTHT %in% valid_samples)

  pb_sub <- pb[, rownames(meta)]

  dge <- DGEList(counts = pb_sub@assays$RNA$counts)
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)

  meta$group <- factor(meta$group, levels = c("Rest", grp))
  meta$IGTHT <- factor(meta$IGTHT)

  design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group + IGTHT, data = meta)

  colnames(design) <- gsub("^group", "", colnames(design))
  colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))

  keep <- filterByExpr(dge, design)

  dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)

  v <- voom(dge, design, plot = FALSE)

  fit <- lmFit(v, design)

  contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(
    contrasts = paste0(make.names(grp), " - Rest"),
    levels = design
  )

  fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
  fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

  tt <- topTable(
    fit2,
    number = Inf,
    adjust.method = "BH",
    sort.by = "P"
  )

  tt$SYMBOL <- rownames(tt)

  vplot <- na.omit(data.frame(
  SYMBOL = tt$SYMBOL,
  fc = 2^(tt$logFC),
  pval = pmax(tt$P.Value, .Machine$double.xmin),
  adj.P.Val = pmax(tt$adj.P.Val, .Machine$double.xmin),
  AveExpr = 2^(tt$AveExpr)
))

p <- Vplot(
  vplot = vplot,
  xlab = paste0(grp, "_vs_Rest"),
  xlimits = range(vplot$fc[vplot$fc > 0], finite = TRUE),
  ylimits = c(min(vplot$adj.P.Val[vplot$adj.P.Val > 0]), 1)
)

sub <- vplot %>%
  filter(abs(log2(fc)) > 2 & adj.P.Val < 1e-30) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(log2(fc)))) %>%
  pull(SYMBOL)

highlight_genes <- unique(c(
  head(sub, 100),
  tail(sub, 100)
))

highlight_filter <- vplot$SYMBOL %in% highlight_genes

pdf(
  paste0(grp, "_vs_Rest_volcano.pdf"),
  width = 10,
  height = 10,
  useDingbats = FALSE
)

print(
  p +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "black")) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = vplot[highlight_filter, ],
      aes(x = fc, y = adj.P.Val, label = SYMBOL),
      color = "black",
      max.overlaps = 40
    )
)

dev.off()
}
```

```{r}
  message("Running: Treg.D", org_title, " vs Treg.A spleen")
  
  group1 <- mdata_orig %>%
    filter(
      annotation_level2 == "Treg.D",
      condition_detailed_simplified == "baseline",
      genetics %in% genetics_keep,
      organ_simplified %in% org
    ) %>%
    pull(cellID)
  
  message("group1 cells: ", length(group1), " | group2 cells: ", length(group2))
  
  if (length(group1) > 0 && length(group2) > 0) {
    res_list[[sprintf("Treg.D_%s_vs_Treg.ASpleen", org_label)]] <- FlashierDGE(
      F1, L1, group1, group2,
      title_plot = sprintf("Treg.D %s vs Treg.A spleen", org_title)
    )
  } else {
    warning("Skipping ", org_title, " because group1 or group2 has 0 cells")
  }
}
```

```{r}
#tcr
tcr <- tcr %>%
  mutate(
    treg_cluster_renamed = case_when(
      lev2 %in% c("Treg_cl1", "Treg_cl7") ~ "Treg.A",
      lev2 == "Treg_cl2" ~ "Treg.D",
      lev2 == "Treg_cl3" ~ "Treg.B",
      lev2 == "Treg_cl4" ~ "Treg.F",
      lev2 == "Treg_cl6" ~ "Treg.C",
      lev2 == "Treg_cl8" ~ "Treg.E",
      lev2 %in% c("Treg_prolif", "Treg_miniverse") ~ NA_character_,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(treg_cluster_renamed))


cluster_order <- c(
  "Treg.A",
  "Treg.D",
  "Treg.B",
  "Treg.F",
  "Treg.C",
  "Treg.E"
)

tcr$treg_cluster_renamed <- factor(
  tcr$treg_cluster_renamed,
  levels = cluster_order
)

cluster_clones <- tcr %>%
  filter(!is.na(clonotype.alpha.beta)) %>%
  distinct(treg_cluster_renamed, clonotype.alpha.beta) %>%
  group_by(treg_cluster_renamed) %>%
  summarise(clonotypes = list(unique(clonotype.alpha.beta)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(treg_cluster_renamed)

jaccard_fun <- function(x, y) {
  length(intersect(x, y)) / length(union(x, y))
}

jaccard_matrix <- outer(
  cluster_clones$clonotypes,
  cluster_clones$clonotypes,
  Vectorize(jaccard_fun)
)

rownames(jaccard_matrix) <- as.character(cluster_clones$treg_cluster_renamed)
colnames(jaccard_matrix) <- as.character(cluster_clones$treg_cluster_renamed)

jaccard_matrix <- jaccard_matrix[
  cluster_order,
  cluster_order
]

write.csv(jaccard_matrix, "Treg_clonotype_jaccard.csv")

jaccard_df <- as.data.frame(jaccard_matrix) %>%
  rownames_to_column("cluster")


#jaccard heatmap
mycols <- colorRampPalette(
  c("darkblue", "darkgreen",
    "gold", "darkorange", "red")
)(100)

pheatmap(
  jaccard_matrix,
  color = mycols,
  cellwidth = 12,
  cellheight = 12,
  breaks = seq(0, 0.05, length.out = 101),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE
)
#scatter plot showing clonal expansion
#y = % cells w/ expanded clonotyes (doesn't have to be in the same cluster) x = # cells per cluster x10^3

scatter <- tcr %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = case_when(
      lev2 %in% c("Treg_cl1", "Treg_cl7") ~ "Treg.A",
      lev2 == "Treg_cl2" ~ "Treg.D",
      lev2 == "Treg_cl3" ~ "Treg.B",
      lev2 == "Treg_cl4" ~ "Treg.F",
      lev2 == "Treg_cl6" ~ "Treg.C",
      lev2 == "Treg_cl8" ~ "Treg.E",
      lev2 == "Treg_prolif" ~ "Treg.P",
      lev2 == "Treg_miniverse" ~ "Treg.wM",
      TRUE ~ lev2
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(cluster, clonotype.alpha.beta) %>%
  mutate(clonotype_size_in_cluster = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells = n(),
    pct_expanded = 100 * mean(clonotype_size_in_cluster > 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


ggplot(scatter, aes(x = n_cells / 1000, y = pct_expanded)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = cluster), size = 5) +
  labs(
    x = expression(paste("# of cells in cluster (x10"^3, ")")),
    y = "% of cells with expanded clonotypes"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```

```{r}
#clonoype sharing mde
color_palette <- read.csv("immgent_color_palettes_level2_1.csv", header = FALSE)
palette_vector <- setNames(
  as.character(color_palette$V2), 
  as.character(color_palette$V1))

## read in seurat object
#CD4 <- readRDS("N:/CBDM_Lab/Odhran/scVerse/ImmgenT_freeze_20250109/New_annotations/Subgroups/CD4/igt1_104_CD4_withtotalvi20260212.Rds")

## save mde co-ordinates into a dataframe to use downstream for plotting
treg_object_clean <- subset(treg_object, subset = !annotation_level2 %in% c("Treg.P", "Treg.wM"))
treg_mde <- as.data.frame(treg_object_clean@reductions$mde_incremental@cell.embeddings)
treg_mde$level2 <- treg_object_clean$annotation_level2
write.csv(treg_mde, "treg_mde.csv", row.names = T, quote = F)

## Get centroids in MDE space - used to plot the centre of each cluster
mde_centroids <- as.data.frame(matrix(ncol = 2, nrow = length(unique(treg_mde$level2))))
rownames(mde_centroids) <- sort(unique(treg_mde$level2))
colnames(mde_centroids) <- colnames(treg_mde)[-c(length(colnames(treg_mde)))]
mde_centroids$level2 <- rownames(mde_centroids)
for (name in rownames(mde_centroids)) {
  mde_group <- treg_mde[treg_mde$level2 == name, ]
  for (i in 1:(length(colnames(mde_centroids)) - 1) ) {
  mde_centroids[name, i] <- mean(mde_group[, i])
  }
}

## Set co-ordinates of cluster centroids yourself if they appear off initially - based on UMAP co-ordinates

##calculate centroid for each cluster

mde_centroids["Treg.A", ]$mdeincremental_1 <- -0.50
mde_centroids["Treg.A", ]$mdeincremental_2 <- -1.2
mde_centroids["Treg.B", ]$mdeincremental_1 <- -0.053
mde_centroids["Treg.B", ]$mdeincremental_2 <- -0.026
mde_centroids["Treg.C", ]$mdeincremental_1 <- 0.72
mde_centroids["Treg.C", ]$mdeincremental_2 <- 0.003
mde_centroids["Treg.D", ]$mdeincremental_1 <- -0.35
mde_centroids["Treg.D", ]$mdeincremental_2 <- 0.87
mde_centroids["Treg.E", ]$mdeincremental_1 <- -0.92
mde_centroids["Treg.E", ]$mdeincremental_2  <- 1.1
mde_centroids["Treg.F", ]$mdeincremental_1 <- -0.04792607
mde_centroids["Treg.F", ]$mdeincremental_2  <- 0.96616011
write.csv(mde_centroids, "mde_centroids.csv", row.names = T, quote = F)
  


## Plot points with centroids 
points_centroids <- ggplot() + geom_point_rast(treg_mde, mapping = aes(x = mdeincremental_1, y = mdeincremental_2, colour = level2), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) + 
  geom_point(mde_centroids, mapping = aes(x = mdeincremental_1, y = mdeincremental_2), size = 10, colour = "black") +
  geom_point(mde_centroids, mapping = aes(x = mdeincremental_1, y = mdeincremental_2, colour = level2), size = 8) + scale_colour_manual(values = palette_vector) +
  theme_classic() + NoLegend()
pdf("Points_Centroids.pdf", width = 15, height = 15)
points_centroids
dev.off()

## All
line_pairs_All <- read.csv("Treg_clonotype_jaccard.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

line_pairs_long <- line_pairs_All %>%
  rownames_to_column("X1") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -X1,
    names_to = "X2",
    values_to = "X3"
  ) %>%
  filter(X1 != X2)


#line_pairs_All <- line_pairs_All[line_pairs_All$X1 != line_pairs_All$X2, ]  ## no duplicates
#library(dplyr)

## create the pairs for plotting - this helps you plot the line to connect any two clusters that you want to connect
centroid_pairs <- merge(
  mde_centroids,
  mde_centroids,
  by = NULL
) %>%
  filter(level2.x < level2.y)

line_pairs_long$mdeincremental_1.x <- NA_real_
line_pairs_long$mdeincremental_2.x <- NA_real_
line_pairs_long$mdeincremental_1.y <- NA_real_
line_pairs_long$mdeincremental_2.y <- NA_real_

for (i in seq_len(nrow(line_pairs_long))) {
  # Try the pair in both orientations since centroid_pairs only stores alphabetical order
  single_pair <- centroid_pairs[
    (centroid_pairs$level2.x == line_pairs_long$X1[i] & centroid_pairs$level2.y == line_pairs_long$X2[i]) |
      (centroid_pairs$level2.x == line_pairs_long$X2[i] & centroid_pairs$level2.y == line_pairs_long$X1[i]), 
  ]
  if (nrow(single_pair) > 0) {
    line_pairs_long$mdeincremental_1.x[i] <- single_pair$mdeincremental_1.x
    line_pairs_long$mdeincremental_2.x[i] <- single_pair$mdeincremental_2.x
    line_pairs_long$mdeincremental_1.y[i] <- single_pair$mdeincremental_1.y
    line_pairs_long$mdeincremental_2.y[i] <- single_pair$mdeincremental_2.y
  }
}

line_pairs_long <- line_pairs_long[!is.na(line_pairs_long$mdeincremental_1.x), ]
## add co-ordinates to final dataframe for each pair for plotting
line_pairs_long$mdeincremental_1.x <- as.numeric(line_pairs_long$mdeincremental_1.x)
line_pairs_long$mdeincremental_2.x <- as.numeric(line_pairs_long$mdeincremental_2.x)
line_pairs_long$mdeincremental_1.y <- as.numeric(line_pairs_long$mdeincremental_1.y)
line_pairs_long$mdeincremental_2.y <- as.numeric(line_pairs_long$mdeincremental_2.y)

## OPTIONAL - Filter out those with low jaccard index
#line_pairs_All <- line_pairs_All[line_pairs_All$X3 > 0.1, ]

## Create plot with legend - uncomment "# + NoLegend()" to remove legend
All_plot_legend <- ggplot() + geom_point_rast(treg_mde, mapping = aes(x = mdeincremental_1, y = mdeincremental_2, colour = level2), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) + 
  geom_point(mde_centroids[mde_centroids$level2 %in% line_pairs_long$X1 | mde_centroids$level2 %in% line_pairs_long$X2, ], mapping = aes(x = mdeincremental_1, y = mdeincremental_2), size = 8 , colour = "black") +
  geom_point(mde_centroids[mde_centroids$level2 %in% line_pairs_long$X1 | mde_centroids$level2 %in% line_pairs_long$X2, ], mapping = aes(x = mdeincremental_1, y = mdeincremental_2, colour = level2), size = 7) + scale_colour_manual(values = palette_vector) +
  geom_segment(data = line_pairs_long, aes(x = mdeincremental_1.x, y = mdeincremental_2.x, xend = mdeincremental_1.y, yend = mdeincremental_2.y, linewidth = X3)) + #, arrow = arrow(length = unit(2.5, "mm"), type = "closed", ends = "both")) + 
 # scale_linewidth(range = c(0.2, 1.5)) +
  scale_linewidth(range = c(100*min(line_pairs_long$X3), 100*max(line_pairs_long$X3))) +  ## scale linewidth to show differene in linewidth
  theme_classic()  + NoLegend()

## Save plot as pdf
pdf("All_Plot_Points_Centroids_lines_legend.pdf", width = 15, height = 15)
All_plot_legend
dev.off()
```

```{r}
#3f heatmap
#3j - heatmap of colon, lung, ln, SI top dge compared to baseline (spleen) - TOP 50 UP GENES
lfc_thresh <- 1
top_n <- 50
assay_use <- "RNA"

organ_col <- "organ_simplified"
cluster_col <- "annotation_level2"

trega_label <- "Treg.A"
baseline_org <- "spleen"
org_to_compare <- c("LN", "small intestine LP", "colon LP")
min_cells <- 10

remove_gene_pattern <- "^Gm|^mt-|^Rpl|^Rps|^Snor|^Mir|^Linc|^Rp[sl]|-ps|Rik$|^Hbb"

DefaultAssay(treg_object) <- assay_use

obj <- subset(
  treg_object,
  subset = igt_number == "67" &
    organ_simplified != "thymus" &
    annotation_level2 == trega_label
)

org_to_compare <- intersect(org_to_compare, unique(obj@meta.data[[organ_col]]))

results_list <- list()

for (org in org_to_compare) {
  
  message("Running ", org, " vs ", baseline_org)
  
  cells_target <- colnames(obj)[obj@meta.data[[organ_col]] == org]
  cells_base <- colnames(obj)[obj@meta.data[[organ_col]] == baseline_org]
  
  if (length(cells_target) < min_cells || length(cells_base) < min_cells) {
    message("Skipping ", org, ": target=", length(cells_target), ", spleen=", length(cells_base))
    next
  }
  
  sub <- subset(obj, cells = c(cells_target, cells_base))
  sub$grp <- ifelse(sub@meta.data[[organ_col]] == org, org, baseline_org)
  Idents(sub) <- "grp"
  
  markers <- FindMarkers(
    sub,
    ident.1 = org,
    ident.2 = baseline_org,
    assay = assay_use,
    logfc.threshold = 0,
    min.pct = 0.1,
    test.use = "wilcox",
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  if (!nrow(markers)) next
  
  res <- markers %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    filter(!grepl(remove_gene_pattern, gene, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
    rename(logFC = avg_log2FC) %>%
    mutate(
      p_val_adj = pmax(p_val_adj, .Machine$double.xmin),
      source_organ = org
    ) %>%
    filter(logFC > lfc_thresh) %>%
    arrange(desc(logFC), p_val_adj) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n)
  
  if (nrow(res)) {
    results_list[[org]] <- res
  }
}

if (!length(results_list)) {
  stop("No upregulated DE results passed the filters.")
}

combined <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
  mutate(
    source_organ = factor(source_organ, levels = org_to_compare)
  )

gene_order_df <- combined %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  slice_max(logFC, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(source_organ, desc(logFC), p_val_adj)

gene_order <- gene_order_df$gene

heatmap_df <- combined %>%
  select(gene, source_organ, logFC) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = gene,
    names_from = source_organ,
    values_from = logFC,
    values_fill = 0
  )

heatmap_mat <- heatmap_df %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

heatmap_mat[!is.finite(heatmap_mat)] <- 0

col_order <- c("LN", "small intestine LP", "colon LP")
present_cols <- intersect(col_order, colnames(heatmap_mat))

heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[, present_cols, drop = FALSE]

heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[
  gene_order[gene_order %in% rownames(heatmap_mat)],
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

labels_row <- make.unique(rownames(heatmap_mat))
labels_col <- colnames(heatmap_mat)

n_genes <- nrow(heatmap_mat)
fontsize_row <- max(4, min(10, 300 / n_genes))

pdf(
  "heatmap_TregA_LN_SI_colon_vs_spleen_top50_UP_ordered_by_logFC.pdf",
  width = 8,
  height = 30,
  useDingbats = FALSE
)

pheatmap(
  heatmap_mat,
  scale = "none",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  labels_row = labels_row,
  labels_col = labels_col,
  cellheight = 6,
  cellwidth = 12,
  fontsize_row = fontsize_row,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
  border_color = "darkgray",
  main = "Treg.A top 50 upregulated genes vs spleen"
)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
#top 50 genes by log2fc ABSOLUTE VALUE

lfc_thresh <- 1
top_n <- 50
assay_use <- "RNA"

organ_col <- "organ_simplified"
cluster_col <- "annotation_level2"

trega_label <- "Treg.A"
baseline_org <- "spleen"
org_to_compare <- c("LN", "small intestine LP", "colon LP")
min_cells <- 10

remove_gene_pattern <- "^Gm|^mt-|^Rpl|^Rps|^Snor|^Mir|^Linc|^Rp[sl]|-ps|Rik$|^Hbb"

DefaultAssay(treg_object) <- assay_use

obj <- subset(
  treg_object,
  subset = igt_number == "67" &
    organ_simplified != "thymus" &
    annotation_level2 == trega_label
)

org_to_compare <- intersect(org_to_compare, unique(obj@meta.data[[organ_col]]))

results_list <- list()

for (org in org_to_compare) {
  
  message("Running ", org, " vs ", baseline_org)
  
  cells_target <- colnames(obj)[obj@meta.data[[organ_col]] == org]
  cells_base <- colnames(obj)[obj@meta.data[[organ_col]] == baseline_org]
  
  if (length(cells_target) < min_cells || length(cells_base) < min_cells) {
    message("Skipping ", org, ": target=", length(cells_target), ", spleen=", length(cells_base))
    next
  }
  
  sub <- subset(obj, cells = c(cells_target, cells_base))
  sub$grp <- ifelse(sub@meta.data[[organ_col]] == org, org, baseline_org)
  Idents(sub) <- "grp"
  
  markers <- FindMarkers(
    sub,
    ident.1 = org,
    ident.2 = baseline_org,
    assay = assay_use,
    logfc.threshold = 0,
    min.pct = 0.1,
    test.use = "wilcox",
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  if (!nrow(markers)) next
  
  res <- markers %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    filter(!grepl(remove_gene_pattern, gene, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
    rename(logFC = avg_log2FC) %>%
    mutate(
      p_val_adj = pmax(p_val_adj, .Machine$double.xmin),
      source_organ = org
    ) %>%
    filter(abs(logFC) > lfc_thresh) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(logFC)), p_val_adj) %>%
    slice_head(n = top_n)
  
  if (nrow(res)) {
    results_list[[org]] <- res
  }
}

if (!length(results_list)) {
  stop("No DE results passed the filters.")
}

combined <- bind_rows(results_list) %>%
  mutate(
    source_organ = factor(source_organ, levels = org_to_compare)
  )

gene_order_df <- combined %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  slice_max(abs(logFC), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(source_organ, desc(logFC), p_val_adj)

gene_order <- gene_order_df$gene

heatmap_df <- combined %>%
  select(gene, source_organ, logFC) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = gene,
    names_from = source_organ,
    values_from = logFC,
    values_fill = 0
  )

heatmap_mat <- heatmap_df %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene") %>%
  as.matrix()

heatmap_mat[!is.finite(heatmap_mat)] <- 0

col_order <- c("LN", "small intestine LP", "colon LP")
present_cols <- intersect(col_order, colnames(heatmap_mat))

heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[, present_cols, drop = FALSE]

heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[
  gene_order[gene_order %in% rownames(heatmap_mat)],
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

labels_row <- make.unique(rownames(heatmap_mat))
labels_col <- colnames(heatmap_mat)

n_genes <- nrow(heatmap_mat)
fontsize_row <- max(4, min(10, 300 / n_genes))

pdf(
  "heatmap_TregA_LN_SI_colon_vs_spleen_top50_abs_ordered_by_logFC.pdf",
  width = 8,
  height = 30,
  useDingbats = FALSE
)

pheatmap(
  heatmap_mat,

)
```

```{r}
#heatmap w/ flashier dge
L1 <- readRDS("L1.Rds")
F1 <- readRDS("F1.Rds")

top_n <- 50

organ_col <- "organ_simplified"
cluster_col <- "annotation_level2"

trega_label <- "Treg.A"
baseline_org <- "spleen"
org_to_compare <- c("LN", "small intestine LP", "colon LP", "lung", "liver")
min_cells <- 10

genetics_keep <- c("wt", "B6-Foxp3-GFP (B6.Cg-Foxp3tm1Kuch/J)")

remove_gene_pattern <- "^Gm|^mt-|^Rpl|^Rps|^Snor|^Mir|^Linc|^Rp[sl]|-ps|Rik$|^Hbb"

mdata_use <- treg_object@meta.data %>%
  filter(
    # igt_number == "67",
    organ_simplified != "thymus",
    condition_detailed_simplified == "baseline",
    genetics %in% genetics_keep
  )

org_to_compare <- intersect(org_to_compare, unique(mdata_use[[organ_col]]))

group2 <- mdata_use %>%
  filter(
    .data[[cluster_col]] == trega_label,
    .data[[organ_col]] == baseline_org
  ) %>%
  pull(cellID)

message("Treg.A spleen cells: ", length(group2))

if (length(group2) < min_cells) {
  stop("Not enough Treg.A spleen cells.")
}

res_list <- list()

for (org in org_to_compare) {
  
  group1 <- mdata_use %>%
    filter(
      .data[[cluster_col]] == trega_label,
      .data[[organ_col]] == org
    ) %>%
    pull(cellID)
  
  message(org, ": group1 cells = ", length(group1),
          " | spleen cells = ", length(group2))
  
  if (length(group1) < min_cells) {
    warning("Skipping ", org, " because group1 has < ", min_cells, " cells.")
    next
  }
  
  org_label <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", org)
  
  res_list[[org_label]] <- FlashierDGE(
    F1,
    L1,
    group1,
    group2,
    title_plot = sprintf("Treg.A %s vs Treg.A spleen", org)
  )
}

if (!length(res_list)) {
  stop("No FlashierDGE results generated.")
}

diff_list <- lapply(names(res_list), function(nm) {
  
  res_list[[nm]]$diff_genes %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(SYMBOL),
      !grepl(remove_gene_pattern, SYMBOL, ignore.case = TRUE),
      is.finite(log2FC), 
      abs(log2FC) > 0.5
    ) %>%
    group_by(SYMBOL) %>%
    slice_max(abs(log2FC), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(comparison = nm)
})

names(diff_list) <- names(res_list)

combined <- bind_rows(diff_list)

genes_to_plot <- combined %>%
  group_by(comparison) %>%
  slice_max(abs(log2FC), n = top_n, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pull(SYMBOL) %>%
  unique()

heatmap_df <- combined %>%
  filter(SYMBOL %in% genes_to_plot) %>%
  select(SYMBOL, comparison, log2FC) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = SYMBOL,
    names_from = comparison,
    values_from = log2FC,
    values_fill = 0
  )
heatmap_df[,"LN"] = res_list[["LN"]]$diff_genes[rownames(heatmap_df),"log2FC"]
heatmap_df[is.na(heatmap_df)] = 0

heatmap_mat <- heatmap_df %>%
  column_to_rownames("SYMBOL") %>%
  as.matrix()

heatmap_mat[!is.finite(heatmap_mat)] <- 0

col_order <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", org_to_compare)
present_cols <- intersect(col_order, colnames(heatmap_mat))
heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[, present_cols, drop = FALSE]

gene_order_df <- combined %>%
  filter(SYMBOL %in% rownames(heatmap_mat)) %>%
  group_by(SYMBOL) %>%
  slice_max(abs(log2FC), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    comparison = factor(comparison, levels = present_cols)
  ) %>%
  arrange(comparison, desc(abs(log2FC)))

heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[
  gene_order_df$SYMBOL[gene_order_df$SYMBOL %in% rownames(heatmap_mat)],
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

colnames(heatmap_mat) <- gsub("_", " ", colnames(heatmap_mat))

ColorRamp <- rev(colorRampPalette(c("red", "white", "blue"))(100))

pdf(
  "TregA_organ_vs_spleen_FlashierDGE.pdf",
  width = 8,
  height = 20,
  useDingbats = FALSE
)

pheatmap(
  mat = heatmap_mat,
  scale = "none",
  cluster_rows = T,
  cluster_cols = T,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  cellheight = 6,
  cellwidth = 12,
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  breaks = seq(-5, 5, length.out = length(ColorRamp) + 1),
  color = ColorRamp,
  border_color = "darkgray",
  main = "Treg.A tissue vs spleen FlashierDGE log2FC"
)

dev.off()
```
